task.summary:
Add 44 unit tests for multi-agent subsystems + fix CHM null value bug
Tests cover: - Swarm: TeammateSpec, SpawnResult, FileMailbox, InProcessBackend, PermissionSyncProtocol - Coordinator: AgentDefinition, AgentDefinitionsLoader - Bridge: WorkSecret (encode/decode/buildSdkUrl) - Ohmo: GatewayConfig, WorkspaceManager, RuntimeBundle, OhmoSessionBackend, GroupRegistry, OhmoSessionRuntimePool, OhmoGatewayBridge, MessageBus - Tools: AgentTool
Fixed ConcurrentHashMap.put(null) NPE in OhmoSessionRuntimePool — CHM does not allow null values. Replaced null placeholder with empty RuntimeBundle.
Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 <noreply@anthropic.com>
